abandon_criterion.note: none; this is an audit backlog rather than a search

bar.note: d-only gains are compared against same (n,k,w) peers, not a single global bar

direction.expected_value: A clean split of real gains from inflated or soft claims, preventing d-only submissions without evidence.
direction.feasibility: leader_audit.py pair already implements the matched-depth comparison and writes a consumable JSON record; GPU makes 300M trials practical.
direction.hypothesis: Every d-only gain on the board can be classified as credible, redirect, drop, or inconclusive by a 300M-trial matched-depth pair audit.

novelty.against: the board's current d-only peer set
novelty.claim: a complete peer-audit record for every d-only gain

direction.what_a_negative_would_teach: That the board's d-only gains are predominantly soft claims, justifying stricter audit requirements before submission.

campaign.name: Matched-depth peer audits for d-only gains
campaign.notes: Consumes and produces research/audits/peer-audit-*.json. A decision other than credible blocks submission unless a distance revision is filed.
